description: This file contains the implementation of an ASP.NET Core middleware class for centralized error handling. It intercepts exceptions during HTTP request processing, distinguishes between custom RestException and other exceptions, logs errors, and returns JSON-formatted error responses.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling exceptions in ASP.NET Core pipeline, providing error responses with localized messages and logging.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method that invokes the next component in the pipeline and catches exceptions to handle them.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions by setting HTTP status codes, serializing error responses, and logging errors.
